title: The sharp singularity rate for biased symmetric sign matrices

abstractEnglish: Let An be a symmetric random matrix whose entries on and above the diagonal are independent signs, equal to 1 with fixed probability $`p\in(0,1)\setminus\{1/2\}`$. We prove that $`\mathbb P(\det A_n=0)=(p^2+(1-p)^2+o(1))^n`$. The rate is attained by the event that two rows agree.
